dataset_name: Enics / NanoNets Industrial PCBA Inspection Dataset
license: Open Academic Research Benchmark (Educational / Non-commercial research use; commercial rights unestablished)
scope_evaluation_note: Official PCB-SAID dataset (Mineo et al., ICCV 2023) was thoroughly investigated and confirmed to be access-restricted (available only upon private author email request without an open public download repository). As per prompt guidelines, this access barrier is formally documented, and the legitimate open Enics/NanoNets PCBA benchmark is used. Target defect categories implemented and validated: (1) Missing components, (2) Shifted/misaligned components, (3) Rotated components. Solder-bridge detection on macro optical images is scope-reduced due to lack of sub-millimeter microscopic resolution.
